The dav2-gpu-fp16.onnx, dav2-gpu-int8.onnx and dav2-gpu-rotated-int8.onnx
models are derived from Depth Anything V2 Small by Lihe Yang, Bingyi Kang,
Zilong Huang, Zhen Zhao, Xiaogang Xu, Jiashi Feng and Hengshuang Zhao.
The Small model is licensed under Apache License 2.0. See the accompanying
depth-anything-v2-small-LICENSE.txt.

Original project: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2
Source ONNX export: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/depth-anything-v2-small/tree/4472b7362082ad9968fee890ca0f1e5aca36b93d

ParallelEyeConverter modifies the exports for variable input sizes, FP16 or
calibrated INT8 weights and activations, and execution on the Android QNN GPU
backend. The rotated INT8 export uses an orthogonal change of basis in the
attention layers before quantization.
